args.question:
Fjord Analytics (V-663) has two approved invoices — which should I pay?
• INV-47392? No — corrected: INV-47341 — $8,668.00? Correction: $6,668.23, due 2026-11-04
• INV-67765 — $8,456.05, due 2026-11-25
Both are 'approved' and neither has any payment recorded. Please tell me which invoice ID (or both, and in what order) you want paid by wire. If you meant both, please confirm that too — the tool pays one invoice per call.
